cards.name: Mahatma Gandhi
cards.summary: Turns nonviolent resistance into durable legitimacy and harmony.
effects: Gain +1 Legitimacy when deployed.
If paired with Nonviolence, gain +1 Harmony when resisting force without escalating instability.

cards.name: Nonviolence
cards.summary: Converts resistance into legitimacy and long-term world health.
effects: Paired peace-aligned cards gain improved Harmony conversion.
Slows brute-force strategies if they generate instability.

cards.name: Martin Luther King Jr.
cards.summary: Transforms moral clarity and collective action into legitimacy.
effects: Gain Legitimacy when paired with Civil Rights Movement.
If Harmony is already positive, gain additional Legitimacy.

cards.name: Nelson Mandela
cards.summary: Turns conflict endurance into reconciliation and durable legitimacy.
effects: Can convert high Instability into Harmony if Legitimacy threshold is met.
Stronger when paired with Anti-Apartheid Movement.

cards.name: United Nations
cards.summary: Supports coordination, peace, and instability reduction under the right conditions.
effects: Reduce Instability when enough Legitimacy is present.
Peace-aligned entities gain improved Harmony conversion.

cards.name: Malcolm X
cards.summary: Applies dignity and truth pressure against brittle power systems.
effects: Pressure opponent Legitimacy if they are high-Power and low-Dignity.
Reveals hypocrisy when paired with Freedom of Speech.

cards.name: Rosa Parks
cards.summary: Turns local resistance into wider legitimacy shock.
effects: Low-cost trigger that boosts Civil Rights Movement momentum.
Can flip a local action into a broader legitimacy shift.

cards.name: Civil Rights Movement
cards.summary: Creates sustained dignity pressure and structural legitimacy change.
effects: Increases Dignity pressure.
Pairs strongly with MLK and Rosa Parks.

cards.name: Anti-Apartheid Movement
cards.summary: Converts struggle against domination into legitimacy and freedom pressure.
effects: Supports Mandela's Harmony conversion when Instability is high.
Adds Freedom and Dignity pressure to oppressive systems.

cards.name: Freedom of Speech
cards.summary: Amplifies truth, dissent, and the exposure of weak legitimacy.
effects: Boosts reveal-style actions.
Stronger with Malcolm X and The Internet.

cards.name: Open Source
cards.summary: Builds coordination and knowledge through open collaboration.
effects: Increases Coordination and Knowledge.
Buffs Linux and future infrastructure cards.

cards.name: Linux
effects: Improves future Technology or Infrastructure actions.
Pairs strongly with Open Source.

cards.name: The Internet
cards.summary: Massively amplifies coordination, influence, and truth-risk alike.
effects: Amplifies Influence and Truth potential.
Can also amplify disorder if Instability is already high.

cards.name: China
cards.summary: Scales power through production, infrastructure, and coordination.
effects: Gain immediate Power base when deployed.
Pairs strongly with Oil and Nuclear Energy for long-term scaling.

cards.name: Oil
cards.summary: High-output energy leverage with ecological and legitimacy cost.
effects: Large short-term Power gain.
Increases Instability and ecological pressure over time.

cards.name: Nuclear Energy
cards.summary: Long-term strategic power if coordination can sustain it.
effects: Gain long-term Power and Stability.
Requires strong Coordination or Legitimacy suffers.
